read.en: TSMC fell 6.3% on Nov 16 to $373.45, trading $372.50–385.47 on heavy volume (1.34x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($397.5), 10-day ($390.5), 30-day ($419.0), 100-day ($424.7) and 200-day ($403.3). MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 16, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($355.05), and RSI is 38.7.

The drop broke all three written supports ($375.4–396.5), now resistance; the $372.50 low met the Jul 29 low ($372.72). Resistance is $375.4–380.8, then $385.5–390.5 (Nov 16 high, Nov 10 low, 10-day) and $396.5–403.3. Support is $372.5–372.7, then $368 (Nov 6 low) and $351–355 (Nov 5 low, SAR). A close above $380.8 would target $385.5–390.5; below $372.5, $368.
